summary: Report an advisory ETA in a work progress note

replay.detail: ETA uses existing work.progress summaries and history. Handoff clearing writes an ordinary progress summary in the transfer transaction. Existing replay semantics are unchanged.

schema.detail: No replicated vocabulary, database, projection or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: The current work progress authority and lease checks remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: work progress accepts --eta with a positive duration or future RFC3339 timestamp. It adds an absolute UTC ETA, report time and author to the plain summary. Human work show prints the whole note with its age; ordinary raw-note readers are unchanged. A nonempty replacement summary without --eta withdraws it; empty progress keeps it. The updated handoff daemon clears the annotation while preserving material progress text. Revision does not carry it to new step subjects.

downtime.detail: Update the reporting CLI and normally replace the handoff-serving daemon to obtain the new behavior. No service interruption beyond normal daemon replacement is required.

manual.detail: No configuration or migration is needed. ETA is advisory and does not change execution budgets, waits or progress's normal lease renewal.

recovery.detail: Ordinary durable progress claims preserve reports and successful handoff withdrawal through replay. Older daemons can read the text, but an older handoff-serving daemon can retain the annotation at transfer; use the updated daemon for the accepted clearing behavior.
